_note: Switch 'db_backend' to change storage without touching any code.

json_db._comment: Used when db_backend = json. User identity store.

vault_db._comment: Encrypted vault — records, ciphertext, grants, vault audit.

postgres._comment: Used when db_backend = postgres. Reads connection string from env var.

jwt._comment: secret_env is read first; fallback is used ONLY in dev/test mode.

crypto._comment: true = server generates keypair during registration (dev/test only). false = client must supply public_key_hex etc. in the request body (production SSI model).
